name: attic/subversion
description: A Subversion client over WebDAV/DeltaV: the HTTP authentication, the XML of the DeltaV methods, the working-copy bookkeeping and the command line above them.
residual: Named 2026-08-24 out of the unclaimed half of source/: twelve modules that nobody had claimed and that turn out to be one thing -- Od* is the WebDAV/DeltaV half (OdXml builds the DeltaV method bodies), SVN* (rstoll) the Subversion half above it.

In the tree, not in the payload: it compiles headless, but an SDK has no business carrying a version-control client. Moved here rather than deleted because it is a working client and the only one this system has.
